name: Digital Plug Store Locator – Google Maps for WooCommerce & Elementor
author: digitalplugs

sections.description:
Digital Plug Store Locator – Google Maps for WooCommerce & Elementor is a high-performance, modern mapping solution designed to bridge the gap between your website and your physical business locations. Whether you operate 5 or 5,000 stores, this plugin allows customers to find your locations, access instant in-map directions, and filter branches based on custom facilities or services—all without ever leaving your website.

Built with clean code and smart filtering, it ensures lightning-fast map rendering and seamless performance across all mobile and desktop devices.

🔗 Quick Links

  • 🎬 Live Interactive Demo
  • 📚 Step-by-Step Documentation
  • 🔑 How to Get Google Maps API Key
  • 💎 Upgrade to PRO Version

🛠️ Need Help or Custom Development?

Looking for a specific feature or a fully tailored solution for your business? Reach out to help@digital-plugs.com. You will be connected directly with a highly skilled WordPress, PHP, and JavaScript engineer ready to bring your exact vision to life.

External Services

This plugin integrates with and sends data to Google Maps APIs (specifically the Maps JavaScript API, Geocoding API, and Places API) to render the interactive map search, fetch location coordinates, and display autocompleted addresses.
* Data Transmitted: User input addresses, coordinates (latitude/longitude), and your Google Maps API Key are safely transmitted to Google’s servers.
* Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy https://policies.google.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: Google Maps Platform Terms of Service https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms

Features

⚡ FREE VERSION FEATURES

  • 📍 On-Map Instant Directions: Customers can get turn-by-turn routing from their current location directly on your map. No need to redirect them away to the external Google Maps app!
  • 🎯 Smart “Near Me” Detection: One-click geolocation instantly surfaces the closest branches or stores to the user.
  • 🏷️ Unlimited Store Attributes: Add custom tags, services, or facilities (e.g., “WiFi Available”, “Wheelchair Accessible”, “Drive-Thru”) to any store.
  • 🔍 Flexible Frontend Filters: Empowers users to narrow down stores based on the specific attributes and services they need.
  • 🗺️ Map & Satellite Views: Switch easily between standard roadmap views and high-resolution satellite layouts.
  • 🎨 Custom Styles & 10 Built-in Themes: Match your brand identity perfectly. Drop in your own custom JSON map style or pick from 10 beautiful preset maps.
  • 📍 Unique Map Markers: Assign completely unique map pin icons to specific stores or stick to a clean global marker style.
  • 🔄 Instant CSV Import & Export: Populate, update, or backup thousands of storefront locations in just a matter of seconds.
  • 📧 Direct Manager Contacts: Allow customers to reach out to specific branch or store managers directly from the listing.
  • 🌍 Global Multi-Lingual Support: Pre-translated and fully ready for Arabic 🇸🇦, Chinese 🇨🇳, French 🇫🇷, German 🇩🇪, Hindi 🇮🇳, Japanese 🇯🇵, Russian 🇷🇺, Spanish 🇪🇸, and more.

💎 PREMIUM VERSION FEATURES (Take Your Business Further)

Ready to unlock deep e-commerce integrations, advanced page builders, and automated mapping tools? Upgrading to PRO gives your business the ultimate edge:

  • 🎁 Free Installation & 24/7 Priority Support: Premium users receive complimentary, hands-on setup assistance and round-the-clock dedicated technical support to ensure flawless operation.
  • 🛒 Advanced WooCommerce Inventory Sync: Link physical stores to your e-commerce products! Display custom stock tables per store, show product availability locations, and let users filter physical stores by WooCommerce product categories.
  • 🏗️ Drag-and-Drop Elementor Builder: Fully customize your store layouts using dedicated Elementor widgets for search bars, map blocks, multi-filters, and store lists.
  • ⏰ Live “Open / Closed” Badges: Display active opening hours for every individual store (supports custom times, split shifts, or 24/7 schedules) with real-time countdowns.
  • 📸 Immersive Store Galleries: Give customers a glimpse of your locations using an interactive zoom-slider gallery featuring media captions.
  • 🤖 Instant Address Auto-Detection: Save hours of backend entry. Simply start typing an address and the PRO version automatically fills long coordinate and text fields via Places Autocomplete.
  • 🖼️ 4 Predefined Single-Store Page Layouts: Launch dedicated, highly optimized landing pages for individual branches using gorgeous, ready-to-use structural templates.
  • 📐 Multi-Layout Frontend Switchers: Give users ultimate control with layout toggles including Split View, List, Grid, or Map-on-Right options.
  • ⭐ Moderated Store Rating System: Build buyer confidence with an on-site store rating system. Take complete control over who can leave ratings and approve reviews before they show up.
  • 🎨 32+ Exclusive Premium Map Styles: Gain access to an expanded, curated library of gorgeous, professional map designs.

👉 Get Started with Digital Plug Store Locator – Google Maps for WooCommerce & Elementor PRO today!

Shortcode Usage

Simply insert the core shortcode into any page, post, or widget area:
[dpsl_store_locator]

Advanced Layout Customization (Parameters):

  • [dpsl_store_locator show_map="true" show_search="true" show_filter="true" per_page="20"]
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Digital Plug Store Locator – Google Maps for WooCommerce & Elementor, or upload the .zip file downloaded from the repository.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new Store Locator > Settings tab to configure your Google Maps API Key.
  5. Create custom store traits under Store Locator > Attributes.
  6. Add your very first physical storefront under Store Locator > Add New Store.
  7. Place the [dpsl_store_locator] shortcode on any target page.
sections.faq:
Why does my map show a “For Development Purposes Only” message?

This is a standard message from Google when your Google Maps API Key is either missing, typed incorrectly, or does not have an active billing account linked to it. Google gives you a generous free tier every single month, but they require a payment method on file to authenticate queries. You can follow our API Key Setup Guide Here.

Can I link physical store inventories directly to my products?

Yes! This is fully supported in our PRO version. Once upgraded, you can display custom stock tables for specific physical locations directly on your WooCommerce product pages.

Can I use Elementor to design my location listings?

Yes, Elementor compatibility is a core feature of the PRO version. It installs modular widgets (such as search boxes, filters, and custom maps) allowing you to design your layout with absolute pixel-perfect freedom.

How can I translate the plugin text?

The plugin is entirely localized and translation-ready right out of the box. You can easily use tools like Loco Translate, Poedit, or WPML to adapt text domains to your language preferences.
